title: Forms genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for FORM documents (IRS tax forms, government applications). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to. The natural layer-1 host is `form_field` (a kind DocLayNet does not cover — see block_kinds gap).
$comment: Grounds the align_gold generic-tag fallback for the `forms` source. Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.
